name: EOD 2026-09-30
body:
> Eod · Summit Az · 2026-09-30

Wednesday. Summit AZ image fixes, technical check and keyword targeting check.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Alt text: 27 images on 25 pages had placeholder, filename, wrong-city or stock text; rewritten after viewing each image, approved and live.
- Replaced the water filter graphic on 10 water softener city pages with a real Summit softener install photo, and the stock heating photo on 10 water heater city pages with 3 real install photos.
- Technical check (404s, server errors, broken links, redirects, http/https, duplicates, orphans, depth): all clear except /terms-of-use/ and /terms-of-service/ being the same page.
- Keyword check of 185 pages (Rank Math keyword vs what ranks in GSC): no shared keywords, but on 28 pages a different page ranks. Biggest: Tempe plumbing page takes emergency searches, tankless pages outrank water heater pages in 5 cities, statewide drain cleaning outranks Mesa. File: `Summit-AZ-Keyword-Targeting-Audit-2026-10-01.xlsx`.
- Retargeted 2 blog posts to what they already rank for ("signs of a slab leak", "trenchless sewer repair").
- 14 pages had no Google views in 3 months: 3 indexed, 11 not. Requested indexing for 5 (4 others requested Sep 30).

# Follow-ups
- Kim: choose which terms page stays; decide other fixes on the keyword audit Conflicts sheet.
- Scott: does Summit want "emergency plumber" searches at all (not 24/7)? Decides the Tempe fix.
- Re-check the 11 unindexed pages in about a week; Oct 24 rankings for Sep 25 to 26 rewrites.
